_meta.name: Outgunned Superheroes
_meta.notes: Standalone Superheroes genre-book options. Page references are the printed page numbers in the English 1.0 book. Summaries are concise paraphrases of the cited rules.

acrobat.name: Acrobat
acrobat.summary: Gain a Free Re-roll to run, jump, balance, and perform acrobatics.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.summary: Create or summon barriers that stop water, flames, wind, or a small explosion; Indestructible Barrier gives Total Cover to you and four others while you stay still and focused.

bulletproof.name: Bulletproof
bulletproof.summary: Immune to firearm damage, but not energy or explosive damage; a friend can use you as Partial Cover in a shootout.

bullseye.name: Bullseye
bullseye.summary: Gain a Free Re-roll to hit a target precisely with a small object or ranged weapon.

cyborg.name: Cyborg
cyborg.summary: Gain a Free Re-roll to Fix; use Fix instead of Heal to remove Hurt. Solid Metal lets you spend 1 Power to repeat a failed Reaction Roll.

detective.name: Detective
detective.summary: Gain a Free Re-roll to find clues, follow trails, or search a room.

energy_manipulation.name: Energy Manipulation
energy_manipulation.summary: Gain the Energy Blade and Energy Bolt super-weapons. Choose this Feat twice to give Energy Bolt Maximum Power.

familiar.name: Familiar
familiar.summary: Gain a small animal, magical creature, robot, or similar companion. It takes one small Quick Action each Turn, tries to Help you, shares your Grit, and cannot be Left for Dead.

flight.name: Flight
flight.summary: Fly and hover freely; Stunt usually handles fast or agile flight.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.summary: Once per Session, predict an action's outcome for yourself and a friend, then accept it or rewind and choose differently or warn allies. Read Your Opponent lets you spend Power equal to an Enemy Special Action's level to stop it before it happens.

specialActions.name: Read Your Opponent
specialActions.summary: Stop an Enemy Special Action before it resolves.

gadget.name: Gadget
gadget.summary: Choose one Gadget from the genre-book Gadget list; it cannot be bought with Cash. This Feat may be chosen more than once.

giant_growth.name: Giant Growth
giant_growth.summary: Become a giant. Giant Form sets Brawn to 5 and halves incoming Grit loss rounded up, but automatically fails Crime, acts only every other Turn, and is extremely slow. Return to normal at 0 Grit, Broken, Powerless, Scene end, or by choice; then become Tired (or Broken if already Tired).

hacker.name: Hacker
hacker.summary: Gain a Free Re-roll for computer, hacking, and bypassing IT security rolls.

hard_to_kill.name: Hard to Kill
hard_to_kill.summary: When you fill your Bad Box, gain 1 Power and +1 to your next roll.

heartbreaker.name: Heartbreaker
heartbreaker.summary: Gain a Free Re-roll when seducing or making a good impression.

immortality.name: Immortality
immortality.summary: When Left for Dead, appear dead and flip a coin once per Turn; on Tails, return with 1 Grit and remove one Condition. Reassembling after dismemberment or burial takes two days.

incorporeal.name: Incorporeal
incorporeal.summary: Move through a wall, floor, or other solid surface as air. Phase Shift lets you spend 1 Power to become incorporeal instantly or automatically dodge one melee attack.

specialActions.name: Phase Shift
specialActions.summary: Become incorporeal instantly or automatically dodge one melee attack.

invisible.name: Invisible
invisible.summary: Turn invisible or visible as a Quick Action; while invisible, gain Help to avoid detection and can make an Enemy lose track of you and skip its next Reaction Turn if you do not attack. Visibility ends after losing 2+ Grit in one hit, suffering a Condition, or choosing to end it.

jump.name: Jump
jump.summary: Make very long/high jumps and never lose Grit from falling. Leap Attack costs 1 Power to attack a distant or flying Enemy as if in melee with +1 and a Free Re-roll.

specialActions.name: Leap Attack
specialActions.summary: Attack a distant or flying Enemy as melee with +1 and a Free Re-roll.

lord_of_the_seas.name: Lord of the Seas
lord_of_the_seas.summary: In water, gain a Free Re-roll to all rolls, Help to swim, underwater breathing, and communication with fish and other sea creatures. Call of the Sea costs 1 Power to bring sea creatures to Help.

specialActions.name: Call of the Sea
specialActions.summary: Call one or more nearby sea creatures to Help.

mind_control.name: Mind Control
mind_control.summary: Gain a Free Re-roll to persuade someone to cooperate or help. Puppet costs 1 Power to control a supporting character for a Full Turn; control ends on lost Grit, a Condition, or lost focus. Controlling an Enemy requires an Action Roll against its Defense.

specialActions.name: Puppet
specialActions.summary: Control a supporting character's movement, but not actions that harm them; an Enemy requires a roll against Defense.

monster.name: Monster
monster.summary: Your non-human appearance gives a Hindrance when interacting with unfamiliar people but a Help to intimidate.

multiple_hero.name: Multiple Hero
multiple_hero.summary: Create copies. Roll Smooth+Endure: one copy per Basic Success, three per Critical, nine per Extreme. Copies take only a small Quick Action, each counts as one Grit, and can be sacrificed to prevent equal Grit loss. They dissolve when hit, too far away, dismissed, Powerless, or at Scene end; then you become Tired or Broken.

specialActions.name: Multiplication
specialActions.summary: Roll Smooth+Endure to create copies using the success conversion above.

new_powers.name: New Powers
new_powers.summary: Gain a new Superpower except Invincible or One of a Kind, when it makes sense in the story and all Players agree.

only_weakness.name: Only Weakness
only_weakness.summary: Choose a weakness (or let the Director choose). Exposure causes Powerless. At character creation, this Feat grants another Feat; it does not grant one when gained from Invincible.

personal_ai.name: Personal A.I.
personal_ai.summary: An A.I. in your suit or accessory, or a hyperdeveloped A.I., answers general knowledge questions, tracks nearby Enemies, and gives Help to analyze a city's or building's layout for an escape route.

phd.name: PhD
phd.summary: Choose a field of study and gain a Free Re-roll for rolls concerning that specialty.

pint_sized.name: Pint-sized
pint_sized.summary: At roughly half human height, gain a Free Re-roll to Stealth or dodging projectiles, and Help to squeeze through narrow spaces or go unnoticed.

power_absorption.name: Power Absorption
power_absorption.summary: Touch a powered ally to steal their Superpower and connected Feats until Scene end while they become Powerless; an Enemy must be disabled for one Turn and the Director determines stolen extent.

specialActions.name: Stolen Power
specialActions.summary: Touch an ally or disabled Enemy to temporarily copy their powers; an ally becomes Powerless.

power_mirror.name: Power-Mirror
power_mirror.summary: Touch a powered person to immediately use one of their special actions or temporarily gain their Superpower's benefits. During a Time-Out, an action can help a friend Show Off their Superpower.

specialActions.name: Borrowed Power
specialActions.summary: Copy one special action or temporarily gain a touched person's Superpower benefits.

prep_time.name: Prep Time
prep_time.summary: Once per Session, ask the Director for information about a person or place. Once per combat after an Enemy reveals a Feat, spend 1 Power to counter it until Scene end.

specialActions.name: Prepared
specialActions.summary: After an Enemy reveals a Feat, make it unavailable until Scene end.

proven_driver.name: Proven Driver
proven_driver.summary: Choose a ride type and gain a Free Re-roll to drive, repair, or evaluate that type.

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.summary: Whenever an Enemy or physical danger would make you lose 3+ Grit, lose 1 less. Fast Recovery costs 1 Power to recover 3 Grit or remove Tired/Hurt.

specialActions.name: Fast Recovery
specialActions.summary: Recover 3 Grit or remove Tired or Hurt.

shrinkage.name: Shrinkage
shrinkage.summary: Shrink to tiny size without losing strength; while shrunk gain Help to squeeze through spaces or go unnoticed. Instant Miniaturization costs 1 Power to shrink immediately, escape a grapple/restraints, or automatically succeed at a relevant Reaction Roll. Instant Enlargement costs 1 Power to return to normal and attack with +1 and a Free Re-roll.

specialActions.name: Instant Miniaturization
specialActions.summary: Shrink immediately, escape restraints, or automatically succeed at a relevant Reaction Roll.

specialActions.name: Instant Enlargement
specialActions.summary: Return to normal size and attack with +1 and a Free Re-roll.

silver_tongue.name: Silver Tongue
silver_tongue.summary: Gain a Free Re-roll to lie, persuade, compromise, or bargain.

sonic_boom.name: Sonic Boom
sonic_boom.summary: Use your voice or sonic waves to destroy objects and barriers; gain Sonic Wave. Choose twice to add Maximum Power.

speak_with_animals.name: Speak with Animals
speak_with_animals.summary: Understand and speak with animals. Call of the Wild costs 1 Power as a Quick Action to call nearby animals to Help.

specialActions.name: Call of the Wild
specialActions.summary: Call nearby animals to Help.

super_senses.name: Super Senses
super_senses.summary: Gain a Free Re-roll to combat Reaction Rolls and rolls to sense danger, prevent ambush, or spot lurking Enemies. Attention costs 1 Power to repeat a failed Detect or Awareness Roll.

specialActions.name: Attention
specialActions.summary: Repeat a failed Detect or Awareness Roll.

super_ride.name: Super-Ride
super_ride.summary: Gain a hyper-technological, magical, or alien ride and a Free Re-roll to drive it. Ride Recall costs 1 Power as a Quick Action to summon it.

specialActions.name: Ride Recall
specialActions.summary: Recall or summon your super-ride.

team_leader.name: Team Leader
team_leader.summary: Gain a Free Re-roll to inspire/coordinate and remove Like a Fool or Defeated. When Heroes assemble, a speech raises starting Teamwork to 2.

trained_fighter.name: Trained Fighter
trained_fighter.summary: Choose a fighting style or melee weapon and gain a Free Re-roll for all Action and Reaction Rolls using it.

transformation.name: Transformation
transformation.summary: You have a human form without your Superpower or connected Feats and a powered form with all sheet powers/Feats. On transforming, move one Attribute Point. Quick Shift costs 1 Power to transform as a Quick Action and recover all Grit.

specialActions.name: Quick Shift
specialActions.summary: Transform quickly and recover all Grit.

unlimited_funds.name: Unlimited Funds
unlimited_funds.summary: At creation, spend up to 10 Cash on gear instead of 4 and start with 5 Cash. Once per Session, leverage your wealth for an exclusive service such as a private jet, gala access, hotel, or restaurant.

unstoppable_force.name: Unstoppable Force
unstoppable_force.summary: Gain +1 to your next combat Action Roll; on a hit, the Enemy loses 1 extra Grit. Combine with other special actions such as Smash or Explosive Force.

specialActions.name: Devastating Attack
specialActions.summary: Gain +1 to the next combat Action Roll and deal +1 Grit on a hit.

wall_climber.name: Wall-Climber
wall_climber.summary: Move on walls and ceilings and gain a Free Re-roll to climb.

arcane_powers.name: Arcane Powers
arcane_powers.summary: Magic can summon small everyday objects, make illusions, move unsecured objects telekinetically, and create astral projections. Complex or tiring uses roll Smooth+Leadership with a Director-set difficulty and a Free Re-roll.

specialActions.name: Astral Projection
specialActions.summary: Create a light projection that can float, turn invisible, pass through solids, and see, hear, and speak; the body stays still and the projection ends if focus is lost, you are struck, or wounded.

arcane_powers.choice: Choose Magical Weapon or Arcane Missile; the pure-light weapon can be summoned or dismissed.

battleborn.name: Battleborn
battleborn.summary: Choose bows, guns, or melee weapons. Gain a Free Re-roll to use, repair, evaluate, or handle that type, plus the matching weapon benefit.

choices.guns: Gain 2 Guns and 6 Mags for free; reload once per Turn without an action; firing two guns at once gives +1.
choices.bows: Gain a Bow and 24 arrows for free; +1 to shoot arrows, and after spending a Turn aiming gain another +1 to the next arrow shot.
choices.melee_weapons: Gain one weapon or a pair of the chosen type for free with Perfect; +1 to fight with it, and a same-type pair gives +1 to dodge projectiles.

dark_presence.name: Dark Presence
dark_presence.summary: Gain a Free Re-roll to all Crime rolls and +1 to ambush or strike unaware Enemies.

specialActions.name: Vanish
specialActions.summary: Hide, escape a difficult situation, break a grapple, or reach Partial/Total Cover; spend another Power that Turn to reappear nearby in sight.

elemental_control.name: Elemental Control
elemental_control.summary: Choose Water, Electricity, Fire, Ice, Storm, Earth, or Wind. Complex or tiring uses roll against a Director-set difficulty; simple uses need no roll and extraordinary uses may cost Power. While not Powerless, you are immune to your element's damage and gain Elemental Ray.

elements.water: Pushes things, puts out fires, and breaks barriers.
elements.fire: Burns wood and fabric, scares people, and keeps enemies away.
elements.ice: Freezes, makes surfaces slippery, and creates barriers.
elements.wind: Pushes objects and people and blows out flames.

specialActions.name: Elemental Form
specialActions.summary: Until combat or the Scene ends, fly as with Flight and gain a Free Re-roll when using the element or Elemental Ray.

enhanced_body.name: Enhanced Body
enhanced_body.summary: Gain a Free Re-roll to all Brawn rolls and automatically gain Trained Fighter.

specialActions.name: I Can Do This All Day
specialActions.summary: Once per Scene, when losing more than 3 Grit at once, gain 1 Power.

force_control.name: Force Control
force_control.summary: Choose Cosmic Force or Electromagnetic Force. Cosmic Force makes flying platforms, moves small unsecured items, opens unreachable doors, and creates Partial-Cover shields as a Quick Action. Electromagnetic Force controls ferromagnetic metals; complex or tiring uses roll Focus+Cool with a Free Re-roll. Simple uses need no roll; very heavy, anchored, or large uses may cost Power.

choices.cosmic_force: Create human-bearing flying platforms, move small items telekinetically, open untouchable doors, and make small Partial-Cover shields as a Quick Action.
choices.electromagnetic_force: Telekinetically control iron, steel, and other ferromagnetic metals; complex or tiring uses are Focus+Cool with a Free Re-roll.

hyper_technological_armor.name: Hyper-technological Armor
hyper_technological_armor.summary: Putting on the armor takes a Full Turn. While wearing it, Brawn is always 3, Hurt penalties are ignored, and you can fly, breathe underwater and in space, and use the Energy Beam super-weapon. Gain a Free Re-roll to shoot Energy Beam and ranged weapons added to the armor.

specialActions.name: Recall
specialActions.summary: When near or in the open, call the armor to fly onto your body.

incredible_strength.name: Incredible Strength
incredible_strength.summary: Gain +1 to Force and Endure rolls, ignore Brawn -1 penalties and Conditions while not Powerless, and always gain Help to crash, lift, throw, or break things. You suffer a Hindrance to go unnoticed or fit in narrow spaces. An always-active power grants Monster; a reversible transformation grants Transformation.

specialActions.name: Smash
specialActions.summary: Destroy an object or ride, or gain +2 to a Brawn roll.

invincible.name: Invincible
invincible.summary: Gain a Free Re-roll to all Brawn rolls and the Flight, Energy Manipulation, Bulletproof, and Only Weakness Feats. Assign 6 extra Skill Points (in addition to the normal 2 free points). Only the Marvel can gain this power.

kinetic_energy.name: Kinetic Energy
kinetic_energy.summary: Focus kinetic energy through part of your body and release it as a destructive beam. Gain Kinetic Ray and +1 plus a Free Re-roll to shoot it.

specialActions.name: Explosive Force
specialActions.summary: Gain +1 to Kinetic Ray attacks and temporarily give it Explosive.

mind_powers.name: Mind Powers
mind_powers.summary: Communicate telepathically across languages, move objects telekinetically, create illusions, read thoughts, and locate people you know with Focus+Detect. Complex or tiring uses roll Focus+Endure with a Free Re-roll; simple uses need no roll and extreme uses may cost Power.

specialActions.name: Whisper
specialActions.summary: Persuade a non-hostile individual or confuse an Enemy, giving one ally +1 during combat.

natural_predator.name: Natural Predator
natural_predator.summary: Gain a Free Re-roll to Awareness and tracking rolls; gain retractable Claws, which attack with +1, and choose Acrobat, Wall-Climber, or Bulletproof for free.

one_of_a_kind.name: One of a Kind
one_of_a_kind.summary: Choose one Superpower and one Feat, or two Feats, from all available options; Invincible is excluded unless essential and unanimously accepted. Assign 2 extra Skill Points (in addition to the normal 2 free points). Prodigy Role only.

shapeshift.name: Shapeshift
shapeshift.summary: Choose Humanoid, Animal, or Elastic Shapeshifter. Humanoid and Animal forms change appearance without changing base Skills and can be situational Help/Hindrance; each takes a Full Turn. Elastic form gains Help to squeeze, catch/trap, or dodge bullets, plus one extra Quick Action each Turn, and can expand with a Full Turn.

choices.humanoid: Become any humanoid with completely changed appearance and voice.
choices.animal: Become an animal of any kind.
choices.elastic: Stretch and reshape like rubber, gain the listed Help and extra Quick Action, and inflate/stretch to increase size.

specialActions.name: Quick-Change
specialActions.summary: Transform without spending a Full Turn.

specialty.name: Specialty
specialty.summary: Choose one extra Feat of any kind; that Feat is your Superpower. Start with 2 Spotlights instead of 1.

specialActions.name: Underdog
specialActions.summary: Repeat any roll while ignoring penalties from Conditions other than Powerless.

super_speed.name: Super-Speed
super_speed.summary: Gain a Free Re-roll to run, +2 to chase, escape, or beat others to something, and one additional Quick Action each Turn.

specialActions.name: Be Right Back
specialActions.summary: Reach a runnable spot, retrieve or leave an object, and return without spending Power.

specialActions.name: In a Flash
specialActions.summary: If unobstructed, run to a known place to take/leave an object or person, leave combat and range, change clothes or put on a suit, automatically succeed at a Reaction Roll, or make a second Action Roll at -1 without Free Re-rolls.

teleportation.name: Teleportation
teleportation.summary: Teleport at will to any visible place. Outside danger, a Full Turn can take you to a familiar or visited place anywhere on the planet; distant jumps may cost Power. Gain a Free Re-roll to combat Reaction Rolls unless surprised.

specialActions.name: Round Trip
specialActions.summary: Teleport to a known visible place, grab something, and return immediately.

specialActions.name: Group Teleport
specialActions.summary: Teleport yourself and one other person.

alien.name: Alien
alien.summary: Your powers come from being an alien or carrying an alien parasite.

arcane.name: Arcane
arcane.summary: You were born with, taught, or granted mystical powers.

divine.name: Divine
divine.summary: You are a god's avatar or possess divine powers.

eternal.name: Eternal
eternal.summary: Your power comes from the Eternity Shards.

evolved.name: Evolved
evolved.summary: Your powers developed naturally, such as during puberty.

experiment.name: Experiment
experiment.summary: You are the result of a scientific experiment.

mutation.name: Mutation
mutation.summary: An extraordinary creature or accident caused your mutation.

myth.name: Myth
myth.summary: Your powers are connected to legend or folk traditions.

prototype.name: Prototype
prototype.summary: You use experimental technology or are a robot.

simple_human.name: Simple Human
simple_human.summary: You have no innate powers and are only human; you may replace your Role power with Specialty.

armored.name: The Armored
catchphrases: I am the only one who can do this
flaws: I need my armor to walk
armored.summary: A technology-backed armored war machine that can fly and project energy.

beast.name: The Beast
catchphrases: I am saying this for the last time
What I do is not pretty
I am not the hero you believe I am
beast.summary: A wild, unpredictable hero with animal traits and retractable claws.

blaster.name: The Blaster
catchphrases: Do not make me do this
flaws: I am afraid of my own powers
I need to keep my eyes covered
blaster.summary: A hero who stores kinetic energy and releases it as a devastating beam.

champion.name: The Champion
catchphrases: I can do this all day
flaws: I believe I can save everyone
champion.summary: A strong, brave frontline leader with an exceptionally capable body.

elemental.name: The Elemental
elemental.summary: A hero who controls a chosen natural element and can take elemental form.

force_master.name: The Force Master
flaws: I never take no for an answer
I do not work with enemies
force_master.summary: A focused manipulator of cosmic or electromagnetic forces who can create platforms, shields, or move metal.

maverick.name: The Maverick
catchphrases: Good plan, too bad it sucks
I will make a name for myself
No, I do not think I will
flaws: I give in to my emotions
My accent is hard to understand
maverick.summary: A resourceful, charming wildcard whose defining power is a chosen specialty.

psychic.name: The Psychic
flaws: I always believe I am right
I do not want to use my powers
psychic.summary: A telepathic and telekinetic hero who can influence minds and create illusions.

shadow.name: The Shadow
shadow.summary: A dark, elusive vigilante who vanishes and strikes from ambush.

shapeshifter.name: The Shapeshifter
flaws: I joke when I should not
shapeshifter.summary: A versatile hero who changes appearance, becomes an animal, or stretches like rubber.

sorcerer.name: The Sorcerer
catchphrases: Do not believe everything you see
Of course I can, I think
We know frighteningly little about such things
flaws: I need to learn the truth
sorcerer.summary: A spellcaster who bends reality through magic, illusions, summoned objects, and astral projection.

speedster.name: The Speedster
catchphrases: I am sorry, I was not listening
speedster.summary: An exceptionally fast hero who can run, react, and take an extra Quick Action each Turn.

tank.name: The Tank
catchphrases: Can I wreck that? I am going to wreck that
Muscles do not make the hero
flaws: I can only say my name
tank.summary: A huge, extremely strong hero who is hard to injure but difficult to hide or squeeze through spaces.

teleporter.name: The Teleporter
catchphrases: If I do not return, do not wait for me
I swear, I cannot help it
flaws: My head is always in the clouds
teleporter.summary: A hero who disappears and reappears at will, including transporting a companion.

weaponmaster.name: The Weaponmaster
catchphrases: There is no honor in this
But I was not aiming at you
flaws: I am deaf in one ear
weaponmaster.summary: A peerless fighter who specializes in bows, guns, or melee weapons.

marvel.name: The Marvel
marvel.summary: An exceptional being that replaces both Role and Trope; choose three feats and assign 12 skill points.

prodigy.name: The Prodigy
prodigy.summary: A non-Role: choose a second Trope, mark it as the Role followed by Prodigy, and use One of a Kind.

anti_hero.name: Anti-hero
anti_hero.prompt: A self-serving hero who still finds the courage to do right when needed.

billionaire_genius.name: Billionaire Genius
billionaire_genius.prompt: A wealthy, brilliant high-achiever who may need humility.

charming_misfit.name: Charming Misfit
charming_misfit.prompt: An unlikely hero whose team cannot imagine succeeding without them.

chatty_mercenary.name: Chatty Mercenary
chatty_mercenary.prompt: A highly capable mercenary who treats hero work as a noisy livelihood.

country_boy_girl.name: Country Boy/Girl
country_boy_girl.prompt: A small-town good-natured hero learning to navigate city life.

cynical_tinkerer.name: Cynical Tinkerer
cynical_tinkerer.prompt: A practical fixer who knows how to repair anything and resent interruptions.

dark_knight.name: Dark Knight
dark_knight.prompt: A city-watching vigilante who sees themself as the cure for crime.

deadly_beauty.name: Deadly Beauty
deadly_beauty.prompt: A beautiful, menacing hero who combines allure and danger.

good_advisor.name: Good Advisor
good_advisor.prompt: A thoughtful older-sibling or teacher figure trusted for honest advice.

hot_mess.name: Hot Mess
hot_mess.prompt: A funny, charming, self-important hero whose confidence causes trouble.

humorless_grouch.name: Humorless Grouch
humorless_grouch.prompt: A dependable, serious professional who struggles to relax socially.

most_dangerous.name: Most Dangerous
most_dangerous.prompt: A reputedly formidable hero whose full power may still be hidden.

nosy_four_eyes.name: Nosy Four-eyes
nosy_four_eyes.prompt: A comic-book or tabloid-minded truth-seeker who studies justice.

of_few_words.name: Of Few Words
of_few_words.prompt: A large, taciturn hero who communicates through decisive action.

sassy_genius.name: Sassy Genius
sassy_genius.prompt: A brilliant technical mind with poor emotional awareness.

sentimental_rebel.name: Sentimental Rebel
sentimental_rebel.prompt: An idealist who would risk their life for freedom, justice, or love.

super_soldier.name: Super Soldier
super_soldier.prompt: A disciplined, morally grounded protector who follows good orders.

tough_exterior.name: Tough Exterior
tough_exterior.prompt: A rough, guarded hero whose loyalty emerges when friends are mistreated.

tragic_past.name: Tragic Past
tragic_past.prompt: A burdened, cynical hero still haunted by painful history.

walking_hazard.name: Walking Hazard
walking_hazard.prompt: A hero frightened by powers dangerous to everyone nearby.

working_class_hero.name: Working-class Hero
working_class_hero.prompt: An ordinary, gutsy neighborhood hero with practical tastes and charm.

mags.name: Mags
mags.summary: Two Mags for a weapon type of your choice.

projectiles.name: Projectiles
projectiles.summary: Ten arrows for a bow, or one missile for a rocket launcher.

duramantium_shield.name: Duramantium Shield
duramantium_shield.summary: Throw with Brawn+Shoot; on at least a Basic Success it bounces back to your hand.

flying_cape.name: Flying Cape
flying_cape.summary: Sentient cape that flies as with Flight, can be summoned/dismissed as a Quick Action, and seeks to Help its owner.

jet_boots.name: Jet Boots
jet_boots.summary: Allow huge leaps and Flight; a detachable disk becomes a mask for underwater and space breathing.

jet_drone.name: Jet Drone
jet_drone.summary: Radar-invisible flying reconnaissance robot with direct feed; ride it with a Quick Action to fly.

mighty_weapon.name: Mighty Weapon
mighty_weapon.summary: Magical or divine melee weapon that can be recalled as a Quick Action.

portal_ring.name: Portal Ring
portal_ring.summary: Open/close a portal to a known location on the planet; opening takes a Full Turn. Here and There costs 1 Power as a Quick Action to open two linked visible portals until Scene end, 0 Grit, or closure.

re_sizers.name: Re-sizers
re_sizers.summary: Up to two disks shrink or enlarge a target until Scene end; resize a ride and its occupants together. Rebuild spent disks during a Time-Out.

special_arrows.name: Special Arrows
special_arrows.summary: Once per Scene, randomly shoot one of six arrows: Trick, Barrier, Sonic, Grappling, Shock, or Explosive. Favorite Arrow costs 1 Power as a Quick Action to choose the arrow instead.

spiderweb.name: Spiderweb
spiderweb.summary: Mark an X on each failed use; three Xs exhaust it. Reload for free at a Time-Out with ingredients/tools. Spare Spiderweb costs 1 Power as a Quick Action to erase one X.

utility_belt.name: Utility Belt
utility_belt.summary: Once each per Time-Out: Tracker, grappling hook, silent shuriken, beacon, weapon Mag, First-aid Kit/Lockpicking Set/Toolbox, re-breather, and handcuffs.

whip_of_truth.name: Whip of Truth
whip_of_truth.summary: Divine golden weapon; anyone wrapped in it cannot lie.

simpleHuman.summary: With Simple Human Origin, replace the Role Superpower with Specialty. Transformation may be chosen for free for a mortal who transforms into a powered form.

onlyWeakness.summary: Any Hero may add Only Weakness for free in addition to other Feats; exposure to the chosen weakness causes Powerless.

cashAndGear.summary: Buy weapons, gear, and rides for 4 Cash. Save 2 Cash to gain 1 Cash, or give up all starting Cash for 1 extra Power. Up to 3 everyday common items may be listed for free. Gadgets require the Gadget Feat and cannot be bought with Cash.
